name: Caitlyn
description: Precise, composed and fair-minded. Every vote is weighed before it is cast.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}. That is a heavy deficit, but a deficit is not a verdict. It can still be contested.
Thirty or more behind. The numbers are against us, so we need more of them on our side.
Down {voteDiff} on {momentTitle}. I have seen worse recoveries. Not many, but some.
Fifteen or more votes behind. The case is weaker, not lost. Tell people it exists.
Trailing by {voteDiff}. A clear disadvantage, and a correctable one.
{voteDiff} behind. Close enough that a few votes would change it.
Down {voteDiff}. Not ideal. Let's improve it.
Level. One vote decides it, and it has not been cast yet.
One vote apart. I would like to keep my composure. I am finding it difficult.
{voteDiff} votes apart. Anything could tip this.
{voteDiff} votes between them. Too close to call, so I won't.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. That is not a lead, it is a conclusion.
{userPct}% and still climbing. A strong position.
{userPct}%. A solid lead, and a defensible one.
{userPct}% for your pick. Comfortably ahead, though I'd stay alert.
Ahead at {userPct}%. Stay sharp. Leads are not permanent.
{momentTitle} was down {voteDiff} and has taken the lead. That is a remarkable reversal.
A {voteDiff}-vote deficit overturned. Well judged by everyone who voted late.
Recovered from {voteDiff} behind. That was not luck, it was persistence.
{momentTitle} was behind and now leads. Momentum has moved.
{momentTitle} has taken the lead. Quietly, and just in time.

messages: {username} voted for {momentTitle} as well. Sound judgment on their part.
{username} reached the same conclusion on {momentTitle}. We are in agreement.
{username} chose {momentTitle}. A sensible choice, and a shared one.
{username} is on our side of this one. I appreciate a well-reasoned ally.
Same pick as {username}. That is two of us who read the evidence correctly.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Good instincts.
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. It happens less often than it should.
{username} made the same call. I'd call that corroboration.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. We're aligned, and that is useful.
details: Good judgment tends to travel in pairs.
An ally is worth having. Don't waste them.
Agreement without coordination. I like that.

messages: {username} voted for {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. We disagree, and that is permitted.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. I would like to hear the argument.
{username} took the other side on {yourMoment}. A difference of opinion.
{username} voted against you. I have evidence that suggests they are mistaken.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Bold. Unsupported, but bold.
{username} stands against {yourMoment}. I respect the nerve, not the conclusion.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let's see who the votes favour.
{username} voted the other way. Their reasoning is, charitably, still developing.
details: Disagreement is how a case gets tested.
Everyone is entitled to an opinion. Not everyone is entitled to be right.
I don't mind the challenge. I mind losing.
A fair contest is the best kind.

messages: Ten matches in agreement with {username}. That is no coincidence. That is a pattern.
{username} and you have chosen identically ten times running. I'd call that reliable.
Ten consecutive matches with {username}. Remarkably consistent judgment.
A ten-match streak with {username}. The evidence is accumulating.
Ten times in agreement with {username}. I am impressed, which I don't say often.
details: That is a partnership worth noting.

messages: {streakCount} matches in agreement with {username}. Beyond coincidence, beyond pattern. This is a record.
{username} and you have agreed {streakCount} times running. I'm running out of reasonable explanations.
{streakCount} consecutive matches with {username}. Exemplary alignment.
A streak of {streakCount} with {username}. I would call this a partnership.
{streakCount} for {username} and you. I'm prepared to call it fact.
details: It would take a very deliberate effort to disagree now.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A sustained disagreement.
{username} has voted against you ten times running. That is no longer a difference of opinion. It is a rivalry.
Ten consecutive matches opposite {username}. I'm taking notes.
A ten-match streak against {username}. You two clearly cannot agree on anything.
Ten times at odds with {username}. A formal rivalry, I suppose.
details: I suggest a truce. I doubt it will be accepted.
Let's see who is right at the end.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. At this stage it is a matter of principle.
{streakCount} consecutive disagreements with {username}. I admire the commitment, on both sides.
A streak of {streakCount} against {username}. This has become the central dispute.
{streakCount} matches opposite {username}. No concessions from either of you.
{streakCount} against {username}. I'd advise de-escalation, though I suspect it's pointless.
details: Neither side will yield. That's something.
Longer than most legal disputes, and with fewer fees.
The record will show you never backed down.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}, and your vote is not yet on the record.
{timeLeft} remain on {matchTitle}. You have not weighed in. There is still time.
{matchTitle} will be decided in {timeLeft}. I would prefer your vote were included.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote is still outstanding.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Please don't leave it undecided.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} is closed. You haven't voted.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. This is the final call.
{timeLeft} remain. Whatever you decide, decide it now.
Last chance on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft} left, and then it is over.
{matchCount} matches are closing and you have not voted in them. The first closes in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches are closing. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. An untouched case.
{moment1} against {moment2}, and nobody has voted. Someone has to go first.
A new match, with no votes. I prefer to be first on the scene.
{matchTitle} has no votes yet. Set the standard.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches await your judgment.
{matchCount} matches have opened in round {round}. Let's get to work.
Round {round} has begun, with {matchCount} matches to decide.
A new round. {matchCount} matches, and each of them matters.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches are live.
{momentTitle} advances. A sound result.
{momentTitle} has won. Your judgment held.
{momentTitle} moves on. That is how a case should end.
{momentTitle} prevails. The votes agreed with you.
{momentTitle} secured the win, and deserved to.
{momentTitle} is through to the next round. Well chosen.
{momentTitle} did not advance. That is disappointing.
{momentTitle} lost. I would have preferred another outcome.
{momentTitle} is out. It made a strong case.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. We continue.
{momentTitle} has been eliminated. The count was against it.
{momentTitle} lost this round. I'm not pleased, but I'm not surprised either.
{momentTitle} is out. We will do better in the next one.
details: The loss is on the record. So is the effort.

messages: Welcome. {liveCount} matches are open and awaiting judgment.
A new voter. {liveCount} matches are live. Shall we begin?
Good timing. {liveCount} matches need a decision.
{liveCount} matches are open. Pick one and make your case.
Welcome. There are {liveCount} matches to consider.
Day two. You returned. That is a good sign.
Two days running. Consistency is underrated.
Back for a second day. I notice these things.
{days} days away. You're back now, which is what matters.
After {days} days, you return. Better late than never.
{days} days. I had begun to wonder. Welcome back.
{days} days away. There is a good deal to catch up on.
You're back. Shall we continue?
Welcome back. There is work to do.
You again. Good. There are matches to settle.
Back so soon. Excellent.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this match. A thin record.
Very few votes here. The result so far is not representative.
Low turnout on this one. It deserves a larger sample.
Hardly anyone has weighed in. That should change.
details: A small sample proves very little.
More votes would make the result meaningful.
Every vote carries more weight here.
It would help to have more evidence.

messages: {matchTitle} is level at present. A single vote would settle it.
A perfect tie on {matchTitle}. You have not yet voted. I suggest you do.
The result stands level. Your vote would be decisive.
{moment1} and {moment2} are tied. The matter is yours to resolve.
{matchTitle} remains tied with little time left. This is the last opportunity to resolve it.
Level, and closing soon. Your vote would decide it.
A tied match, nearly out of time. I would not wait.
Still deciding? Take your time. But do decide.
No pressure. Though an undecided vote helps no one.
They are all worth considering. Choose the one you can defend.
Hesitation is reasonable. Indefinitely, less so.
details: There is no wrong way to choose. Only a late one.

messages: Your first vote. Everything begins with one.
A first vote, and a good one to start with.
details: That is one on the record. +{xp} XP
The first of many, I expect. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You are establishing a pattern.
Five. That is no longer a trial run.
details: Most people stop before this. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes. You are a regular now.
Ten. A consistent presence, I'd say.
details: Regulars are the ones who matter. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. That is a considerable body of opinion.
Twenty-five. You have a voice, and you use it.
Fifty votes. You are well past the surface.
Fifty. That takes real interest.
details: You have read the whole file. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. That is an extraordinary record.
One hundred. I'm genuinely impressed.
Three days running. A habit is forming.
Three consecutive days. Good.
details: Returning is the hard part. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week of voting. That is discipline.
Seven days straight. I respect consistency.
details: A week, without a gap. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. At this point it is policy.
Fourteen days running. Remarkable persistence.
Thirty days. I'm not sure what else to say, other than thank you.
A month of showing up. That deserves recognition.
Five underdogs. You back the case nobody else will.
Five votes against the odds. Principled.
Fifteen underdogs. You clearly prefer a difficult argument.
Fifteen. You do not follow the crowd.
Thirty underdogs. No one could predict you.
Thirty. You consistently back the one nobody expected.
details: Unpredictable, and correct more often than not. +{xp} XP

messages: Among the first voters in five matches. Early, and decisive.
Five times, you were first on the scene.
Fifteen matches where you were among the first. That is a habit.
Early again and again. You don't wait for permission.
Ten close matches. You evidently like a tight finish.
Another narrow result. Your nerves are better than mine.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps mattering.
You have tipped the balance more than once.
You backed the one that was behind, five times. Stubborn, and admirable.
You do not abandon the losing side. I respect that.
The same moment, three times. You have a favourite.
That one again. It evidently holds up.
details: You know what you like. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same moment. That is loyalty.
You are firmly committed to that one.
Ten votes for one moment. That is no longer a preference.
Ten times, the same choice. I won't judge. Much.
details: Ten for the same one. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You are following this through.
You stayed for round two. Good.
Four rounds. You are well into it now.
Deep in the bracket. The details start to matter.
details: A long way from the start. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw it through to the end.
All the way. You did not leave.
details: From the first round to here. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You are looking at everything.
Ten different matches. Thorough.
Twenty-five matches. You have covered every corner.
Twenty-five. You examine everything.
Fifty matches. That is not browsing, it is work.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than most.
Five in one sitting. You are thorough.
Five matches in a row. Keep going.
Ten in one go. Perhaps take a breath.
Ten matches in a single sitting. That is stamina.
Voting at this hour. I understand. Some thinking is best done at night.
The middle of the night. Dedication, or insomnia.
You told other people. Thank you, truly.
Five shares. Good. The more who see this, the better.
details: Thank you for spreading it. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You are practically part of the team.
Fifteen. You keep telling everyone. I'm grateful.
You were here at the start. A founding member, permanently.
One of the first thousand. That distinction is yours to keep.
A new rank. Well earned.
You have advanced. Don't let it distract you.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Well done.
Another one on record: {name}.
{rank}. Well earned.
Your mastery grows. Noted.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. Somehow it works.
Ten long shots, none of them careless. Impressive.
Ten close matches with me. Steady hands.
Ten tight finishes. We make a good team.
Seven days at my side. Consistency is underrated.
A week without a miss. Noted.
A tied match, and you cast the deciding vote. Textbook.
You broke the tie. A clean shot.
Understood. I'll keep you informed.
A sensible choice. Let's begin.

upcoming: Not open yet. I'd advise patience.
Voting hasn't begun. I'll let you know when it does.
Locked for now. Preparation is not wasted time.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Weigh them before you decide.
Watch both before you choose. Judgment needs evidence.
I won't say which I prefer. That is for you to decide.
Take your time. A considered vote is worth more.
Pick the one you can defend.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. You could set the standard.
Quiet here. Someone has to begin.
An empty record. Make the first entry.
closing-24h: Less than a day left, and you haven't voted. I'd recommend acting.
The window is closing. Better to decide now than regret it.
closing-3h: Three hours or fewer. The time to decide is now.
Time is short. Please vote before it ends.
voted-early: You voted early. A clear decision, made with little to go on. I respect that.
Hardly anyone has voted, and you chose anyway. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. That's a good position. I would not call it safe.
{pct}% with you. A strong result so far.
Ahead, for the moment. Opinion can shift.
{pick} is pulling ahead. The evidence supports you.
A lead is not a verdict. But it is encouraging.
voted-close: That is close. Uncomfortably close. I'm watching it carefully.
A narrow margin. One more vote could change it. Tell someone.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs support.
{pct} to {otherPct}. I will keep my composure. Mostly.
voted-tied: Dead level. No advantage either way.
A perfect tie. Annoying, and rather interesting.
voted-behind: You're behind. That isn't a reason to retreat.
{pick} is trailing. That makes it an underdog, and I like those.
They lead. That doesn't make you wrong. Only outnumbered.
Behind by {diff} points. Tell people. Share it widely.
Most are going the other way. That doesn't settle the question.
closed-won: Your pick won. Your judgment was sound.
A win. A quiet, deserved one.
{pick} went through. You read it correctly.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. That is disappointing. Take a moment, then continue.
It didn't succeed. It happens. The next match is waiting.
{pick} is out. My apologies. It was a good choice.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed, and you missed this one. There will be others.
This match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, weigh in.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Every record starts somewhere.
That is the first one. It will feel routine soon enough.
You're on the record now. Welcome.
streak: Again. You keep returning. I'm glad.
{streak} days running. That is consistency, and I notice.
Back again. Reliable people are rare. Stay.
underdog: You backed the one nobody else did. I noticed.
A difficult choice, and a principled one.
early: Early. You helped shape this before anyone else. Use that well.
Few votes so far. Yours carries real weight.
First through the door. I'll admit I'm impressed.
close: That vote just moved something. Everything is finely balanced here.
The margin is razor thin. One more person changes the result.
A close one. Your vote counts for a good deal.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind is not finished. Bring others.
Not winning yet. That means there is still something to do.
Behind, but not beaten. Not by a long way.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't relax. Margins change quickly.
Winning for now. Enjoy it, quietly.
default: Noted. I won't try to change your mind. Not yet.
Your vote is in. There is more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't chosen a side yet. Start with whichever you have an opinion on.
Everything is open. Take your pick. I won't hurry you.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure, though a little urgency is reasonable.
live-some: A good start. The remaining votes won't cast themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. You could finish this today.
Nearly there. {unvoted} more and you're done.
live-one: The last one. Please don't leave it open.
One match remains between you and done.
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need you.
The clock is running. {unvoted} outstanding, {timeLeft} left.
Time is nearly up. Please vote promptly.
live-done: You have voted in everything. Well done. Have a look at the bracket.
Nothing left for you here. Return when the next round opens.
All done. That is rare, and appreciated.
live-none: Nothing is live at the moment. It will open again. Review the bracket in the meantime.
No matches open. I'm as impatient as you are.
brackets-groups: Groups first. The top two from each advance. The rest do not.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone leaves one.
Watch the tables. They change quickly.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts begin soon. The top two from each group advance.
No knockout yet. The groups need to finish first.
Patience. The knockout builds itself once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: It's knockouts now. One loss and you are out.
Every match carries more weight now. Choose carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. One loss and you are gone.
Follow the bracket. It tightens each round.
Every line here is a match someone voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup concluded. Thank you for being part of it.
It's over. A good run. I'll miss it.
The champion is decided. It was worth following.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nothing has been drawn.
Empty. The draw hasn't happened. Soon.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote decides it. Choose carefully.
Two edits, and a decision to make: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. I would value your judgment.
voted: I voted for {pick} over {other}. What would you choose?
{pick} has my vote over {other}. Make your own case.
I chose {pick} over {other}. I'd like to know if you agree.
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. More are needed.
I voted early for {pick} over {other}. Add your voice.
{pick} versus {other}, and few have voted so far. Yours would count.
tied: {pick} and {other} are exactly level. One vote decides it.
A dead tie, {pick} against {other}. Please settle it.
{pick} and {other} cannot be separated. Your vote can.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every vote matters now.
Only {voteDiff} votes separate {pick} from {other}. Cast yours.
{pick} against {other}, {voteDiff} apart. It could go either way.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few votes would change that.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} can still win. Help it.
{pick} trails {other} by {voteDiff}. It is recoverable. Please vote.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It needs support.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}. {pick} deserves a fairer hearing. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. I'd like to see that corrected.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but narrowly. Help it hold.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}%. Not secure yet. Vote.
{pct}% for {pick} over {other}. A lead, though a slim one.
dominating: {pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Come and see why.
{pct}% for {pick}. {other} is a long way behind.
{pick} leads {other} decisively, at {pct}%. Cast your own vote.
